svg.title: Useful records have distinct owners
svg.desc: rnd-grill owns approved preparation and domain records, rnd-debug diagnosis, dev-exec optional tickets and handoffs, dev-review its report and dev-spec material built-work project specs without a universal artifact chain.
svg.text: Save only the record the task needs
Ownership, not a pipeline. Reuse established paths; local task records default to .scratch/<feature>/.
Decisions, feature descriptions, evidence and questions
Glossary / ADR changes need separate concrete approval; questions are not sent.
Confirmed cause and class, or exact missing evidence and next probe.
Real prerequisites; preserved identities/history; actual verification and Git state.
Pinned scope/sources, finding verdicts and evidence; selected fixes need no ticket.
Exclusive normal writer; a lowercase feature spec.md is preparation, not built proof.
Small execution can stay artifact-free. A saved record neither starts another skill nor grants new authorization.
Keep existing tickets, journals, decisions and prototypes as context/history; never migrate or delete them implicitly.
